history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with neatly styled dark hair, fair skin, and light eyes is captured in a three-quarter profile, looking off to the right. He is wearing a long-sleeved black collared shirt with an intricate, abstract pattern in a muted gold or beige. His hands are tucked into the pockets of his black pants.

He stands outdoors, leaning slightly against a large, light-colored wooden pillar. Behind him, a modern architectural structure with a slatted wooden roof is visible, allowing sunlight to filter through. To his left, there's a dark, textured stone wall and a small water feature with a gentle cascade of water flowing into a shallow pool of green water. In the background, on the right side, a contemporary seating area with a light-colored sofa and a small table is set up, with a handbag resting on the sofa.

The lighting appears to be natural daylight, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the wood and stone. The color palette is dominated by the dark tones of the man's clothing and the background elements, contrasted by the warm wood and the bright, filtered light from above. The overall mood is relaxed and sophisticated, with a touch of contemporary elegance. The image has a slightly soft focus, adding to its serene atmosphere.
